question: On the declared unit-S3 scalar-derived metric sector, does the linearized ADM momentum constraint project to the canonical gradient-shift generator after the trace/tracefree scalar canonical normalization is fixed?

primary_sources.source: Repository closed-S3 ADM linear scalar convention audit
primary_sources.used_for: shared ADM sign and the earlier psi,E longitudinal coordinate convention
primary_sources.not_used_for: a derivation of full linear constraints or HDA

primary_sources.used_for: unit-S3 scalar-derived tensor norm, divergence and n=1 degeneracy
primary_sources.not_used_for: complete SVT or nonzonal Clebsch-Gordan data
a proof that the scalar-gradient sector alone is closed under shift commutators

declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3, Delta Q_n=-lambda_n Q_n, lambda_n=n(n+2), integral Q_n Q_m=delta_nm
declared_conventions.metric: q_ab=a^2[gamma_ab+2 zeta gamma_ab+2 S_ab(E)] to first order, S_ab(E)=D_aD_bE-gamma_ab Delta E/3
declared_conventions.momentum: delta pi^(ab)=sqrt(gamma)/a^2 [Pi_zeta gamma^(ab)/6 + Pi_E,n S_n^(ab)/(2 N_n^2)], with N_n^2=(2/3)lambda_n(lambda_n-3)
declared_conventions.canonical_pairs: integral delta pi^(ab) delta q_ab=sum_n(Pi_zeta,n delta zeta_n+Pi_E,n delta E_n) for n>=2
declared_conventions.adm_momentum: D_a=-2q_ac nabla_b pi^(bc), linearized about zero perturbative momentum
declared_conventions.coordinate_bridge: zeta=psi+Delta E/3, so delta_L E=L and delta_L zeta=Delta L/3 imply delta_L psi=0
declared_conventions.cutoff: The declared scalar packet retains n=2,3. A gradient-shift-only DD bracket is not claimed closed because commutators can require transverse-vector shift content.

excluded_exceptional_modes.n0: constant scalar has no scalar-derived tensor
excluded_exceptional_modes.n1: S_ab(Q1)=0 and N_1^2=0; no E/Pi_E canonical pair is admitted

exact_plan: derive trace and scalar-derived tracefree symplectic coefficients
derive the projected ADM momentum coefficient from divergence of S_ab(Q_n)
compare the ADM projection with the canonical generator for n=2,3 and gradient shifts Q1,Q2
verify zeta,psi,E coordinate conversion and exceptional-mode exclusions

decision_table.condition: all pins and exact checks pass
decision_table.meaning: only the declared scalar metric variation/generator convention is supported
